matched.timing_boundary: llama-bench pp512/tg128 medians; hipEngine per-generation wall including its own synchronize
matched.output_projection: llama-bench tg128 projects one row per step; hipEngine bulk prefill uses logits_rows=1 (last prompt row only)
matched.warmup: llama-bench -r 3 discards its own warmup; hipEngine runs one unmeasured prefill before the 3 measured generations

llamacpp_tp2_nccl.transport: split-mode tensor, tensor-split 1/1, GGML_CUDA_ALLREDUCE unset (Linux default = NCCL), P2P off

llamacpp_tp2_internal_p2p.transport: split-mode tensor, internal q8 allreduce, P2P enabled

hipengine_tp2_bulk.transport: rank-local bulk prefill, host-staged MLP exchange (hipDeviceCanAccessPeer is 0 both ways on this pair, so direct peer access is unavailable)

reproducibility_of_the_previous_referenc.finding: The TP=1 companion reproduces within 0.7% on the same build (15995a1), model bytes and host, so this is not a host-wide clock or thermal difference. The TP=2 tensor-split number does not reproduce: 1328.4 measured against 1474.6 recorded, -9.9%, and it stays ~1321-1328 under the internal allreduce and P2P flags the historical note attributes to it. Treat 1474.6 as unreproduced until a command that reaches it is recorded.
